name: BridgeDb webservice
what: Live identifier mapping over HTTP, for anything that cannot ship a database.

name: Mapping databases
what: Per-species mapping files, rebuilt from the primary databases and deposited with a DOI. These are department output, not a third party's data.

name: WikiPathways SPARQL endpoint
what: The RDF layer the department builds from the pathway content and serves as queryable linked data. The pathways themselves are curated by the community.

name: wikipathways.org
what: The pathway database itself, which the department co-founded and helps run.

name: R-ODAF
what: The analysis app, hosted so it can be used without installing anything.

name: VHP4Safety platform
what: One entry point to the chemical safety services the consortium runs.

name: AOP-Wiki SPARQL endpoint
what: The AOP-Wiki as queryable RDF, one named graph per release.

name: AOP-Wiki RDF dashboard
what: Charts of the RDF, every one showing the SPARQL query behind it.

name: molAOP Builder
what: Curate key event to pathway mappings, with a confidence assessment.
